description: Long cream fine undertunic beneath burgundy open-front woven noble coat with rich gold geometric borders at front, sleeve edges and hem, broad dark belt with round metal clasp, draped burgundy shoulder cloth fastened with a small jeweled brooch, and brown leather boots. Both hands rest together in front; entire hair and boots have margins. No headgear, armor, weapon or text. Rich patterning remains daily noble textile rather than armor.
